statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail remains well below the block threshold in a calm overnight regime.
recommendation: Orderly post-record overnight session; retracements remain available and no persistent one-way structure is observed. Conditional trend-up risk is flagged only for the Tuesday US cash session (14:00-18:00 UTC danger window).
headline: Calm overnight after Monday's record chip-led close; Tail low, watch the US cash session
body: Monday delivered a record Nasdaq-100 close (30,482, +2.83%) on a Meta Muse / CPU-demand chip rally (ARM, INTC, AMD, QCOM sharply higher). That move decayed orderly from an intraday orange regime back to green into the close. Overnight NQ futures drift modestly higher (~30,843) in a quiet Asian session, with VIX ~14.9, 2Y 4.76% / 10Y 5.01% steady, and WTI easing near $92. No delayed second-leg mechanism is active and retracements remain available, so Tail is held low. Conditional trend-up continuation is possible during the Tuesday US session (Richmond Fed, Fed speakers, 2Y auction), reflected as a narrow 14:00-18:00 UTC danger window rather than a session-wide block.

lookbackSummary: Past 24h: Monday's US session drove a trend-up chip rally, lifting Tail from single digits into an intraday orange peak (33) around 18:00-19:00 UTC before an orderly decay back to green (13) by the overnight session. Stress tracked from low into elevated at the peak and receded; Confidence stayed high throughout.
outlookSummary: Calm overnight base case with Tail low. Forecast tilts conditionally trend-up into the Tuesday US cash session (watch-band Tail, 14:00-18:00 UTC danger window) on possible chip-rally continuation, then normalizes back toward low into Wednesday. Next macro catalyst is Wednesday's S&P Global flash PMIs.
